newsitem.title: UK: Alliance average auction price 522p per shr.
newsitem.headline: Alliance average auction price 522p per shr.

text.p: Newly floated bank Alliance & Leicester said on Monday that the average bid price of shares at the first auction of free shares by members was 522.07814p per share.
It said in a statement that the range of bids by institutions was between 517p and 546p for a total of 52.36 million shares.
This was the first of three auctions and took place between 1530 GMT and 1730 GMT on April 18.
In total about 157 million shares are on offer after members of the former building society opted to sell almost 27 percent of their free share allocation.
The second auction will take place between 1530 GMT and 1730 GMT today.
Shares in the Alliance and Leicester began trading on the London stock exchange today at 542.5p per share.
